claim: There is no additional charge for Amazon ECS orchestration; you pay only for the underlying compute and resources used to run your containerized applications. Exception: for ECS Managed Instances there is an additional management fee per instance for the operational management provided by AWS.

values.display: no additional charge for Amazon ECS orchestration

qualifiers.condition: ECS Managed Instances add a per-instance management fee
